uutiset.t: Musk's plan to send a million SpaceX data satellites into space approved
uutiset.s: The Starmind constellation aims to be the most cost and energy-efficient way to meet the growing demand for AI computing power.

uutiset.t: Two screenings of Pakistani TV show cancelled in India after backlash
uutiset.s: The show, Dar-e-Nijaat, has become a sensation in India but is now embroiled in a political row.

uutiset.t: Guinea orders residents to clean up the capital months after deadly rubbish dump collapse
uutiset.s: The capital's main rubbish dump has been closed since the disaster, leading to rubbish piling up in the streets.

uutiset.t: New UK-EU treaty has 10-year termination clause, BBC understands
uutiset.s: Text of the treaties will be published this afternoon, alongside legislation designed to enact the bulk of the deal.

uutiset.t: FedEx plane overshoots Miami runway, causing brief suspension of flights at airport
uutiset.s: The brief stoppage came on the eve of the US Thanksgiving holiday, one of the busiest travel days of the year.

uutiset.t: Thirteen dead as mine disaster highlights illegal hunt for gold
uutiset.s: Indonesian authorities say another 13 are missing in the illegal gold mine, which flooded on Monday.

uutiset.t: DR Congo demands answers over Ugandan general's threats
uutiset.s: Gen Kainerugaba threatened a rebel takeover of a mineral-rich area in DR Congo in controversial X posts.

uutiset.t: Desperate appeals from women on death row in Iran after protests
uutiset.s: Female protesters and dissidents are being sentenced to death in numbers not seen for decades, a rights group says.

uutiset.t: Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor dies aged 65
uutiset.s: The musician, who co-wrote some of the band's biggest hits, had been treated for prostate cancer.

uutiset.t: Watch: BBC confronts German man suspected of supplying migrant gangs with small boats
uutiset.s: Marvin Reuter is contesting extradition to France, where he could face smuggling, criminal conspiracy and involuntary manslaughter charges.

uutiset.t: German boat dealer suspected of supplying Channel smuggling gangs, BBC finds
uutiset.s: Nearly a third of crossings in early 2026 allegedly involved boats or engines from the German man's firm.

uutiset.t: US announces new tariffs on host of countries including China
uutiset.s: The new levies would hit many of America's biggest trading partners, including China and the EU.

uutiset.t: Macy's postpones Thanksgiving parade due to severe weather
uutiset.s: The was the first time ever that the iconic celebration was delayed because of storms. New York expects damaging winds and heavy rainfall over the Thanksgiving holiday.

uutiset.t: California warns of flooding as King Tides peak over Thanksgiving
uutiset.s: Parts of the Canadian province of British Columbia may also be affected by the storms and flooding, which come as millions of people travel for the holiday.

uutiset.t: US Army says controlled blast of explosives in Iowa was 'huge success'
uutiset.s: Despite widespread concern from residents ahead of the blast, officials say that lead readings in the area so far have been promising.
